title: D3.js
summary: Data diagrams in the HUD style: bars, trend lines, gauges, flow bands, treemaps, bump and candlestick charts, heat grids, networks, radial and circuit trees, a dot-matrix map, rolling counters and signal scopes. Each boots up, builds, then keeps moving. Use them full-screen as cutaways, or pass "clear": true to float them over footage.

items.name: Bar chart
items.description: Bars built from segments that light up from the baseline.

items.name: Line chart
items.description: A trend line traced by crosshairs, ending on a called-out value.

items.name: Ring gauge
items.description: Shares of a whole as arcs on a dial with the total in the centre.

items.name: Node graph
items.description: Process steps as linked nodes with travelling pulses.

items.name: Radar
items.description: A sweep that discovers labelled contacts.

items.name: Versus bars
items.description: Two contenders compared metric by metric with bars growing out from a centre spine.

items.name: Stacked area
items.description: Layered areas revealed by a scanning cursor that keeps reading out each layer.

items.name: Funnel
items.description: Stages switching on from the top while particles fall through and thin out.

items.name: Percent grid
items.description: A hundred cells lighting up by category, one per unit, with running totals.

items.name: Flow bands
items.description: Bands pouring from sources to destinations, carrying small packets.

items.name: Dot map
items.description: A stylised dot-matrix world map revealed by a scan beam, with pinging hotspots and a ranked readout.

items.name: Timeline
items.description: A playhead running down a rail, switching each milestone on as it passes.

items.name: Orbit
items.description: Bodies circling a core on ringed orbits, trailing arcs. Loops.

items.name: Chord network
items.description: Members on a ring joined by ribbons, with a highlight stepping from link to link.

items.name: Circuit tree
items.description: A hierarchy with circuit-board elbows and packets travelling to every leaf.

items.name: Odometer
items.description: One big number on rolling digit wheels that lock in one by one.

items.name: Gauge cluster
items.description: One large dial and smaller ones beneath, with needles that overshoot and tremble.

items.name: Data table
items.description: Rows that type themselves in: decoding names, counting numbers, status chips.

items.name: Oscilloscope
items.description: Two scrolling traces on a scope grid with a cursor reading the level. Loops.

items.name: Spectrum
items.description: Bouncing equaliser columns with falling peak caps and a reflection. Loops.

items.name: Treemap
items.description: A block that is cut in two again and again until every item has a cell sized by its value.

items.name: Bump chart
items.description: Rank over time with crossing lines, rank badges and each contender highlighted in turn.

items.name: Candlesticks
items.description: Candles printing one by one with a riding price tag, moving average, volume and a roaming crosshair.

items.name: Calendar heat grid
items.description: One cell per day filled by a sweeping cursor, weekly totals, and the longest run traced out.

items.name: Parallel coordinates
items.description: One axis per measure, one line per item; value markers glide to each item in turn.

items.name: Spider chart
items.description: Radar-area shapes pushing out corner by corner on a web, with a circling sweep.

items.name: Network
items.description: A force-laid-out network that grows outward from one node, then drifts while packets run the links.

items.name: Radial tree
items.description: Branches leaving a hub along spokes and arcs, with a sweep lighting each leaf.

items.name: 3D bar chart
items.description: A grid of glowing columns in 3D on a floor plane while the camera circles it; columns rise in a ripple from the centre, then breathe on a wave. Full frame, made for a cutaway. Props: title, unit, size (columns per side), turn (degrees the camera circles), seed.
